_comment: Optional override for the registry-proof plan job (bin/last-stack-registry-proof-plan select-build). `target` null means: prove public lastdb main when the index has no row for that build, else prove the newest build in registry/next.json. Set target to {"build": "<git describe build>", "fold_oid": "<optional 40-hex>"} to force one build, for example after a hand rollback. fold_oid empty = resolved from the build's short oid through the GitHub lastdb repo (pre-cutover 0.23.2 and 0.23.3 builds use archived fold). The plan reads no Mac state. Design: brain design-registry-proof-in-github-ci-20260930 (D4).
